name: zoxide-plus
title: Zoxide Plus
description: Jump straight to any folder on your Mac by name. Type a few letters, hit enter, and open it in Finder, your terminal, or your editor — ranked by how often and recently you've used it, powered by zoxide.
author: Unlockhomes

commands.name: jump-to-folder
commands.title: Jump to Folder
commands.subtitle: Zoxide
commands.description: Search your zoxide directory index and open the match

commands.name: add-path
commands.title: Add Path to Zoxide
commands.description: Add a folder to zoxide's frecency index. Uses the selected folder in Finder (or the containing folder if a file is selected); falls back to a folder picker when Finder has no selection.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal app used by the "Open in Terminal" action

preferences.name: editor
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Editor app used by the "Open in Editor" action

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
